entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2839853133694170880: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 115623: distance 52.247 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.009), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 52.247 +/- 0.47 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 18.7061 +/- 0.1356 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05), 137.9 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 191.856, 36.183 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2839853133694170880 (quality B), from 2008AJ....135..209M; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 5.711 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 115623: radius 5.711 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 37.449 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.043) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5979 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 115623: effective temperature 5979 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.053).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 1115: HR 8905; VizieR III/202, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fffafd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 220657 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 8905 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 8905 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 8905 is not in part2; kharitonov: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,979 K and log g 3.32 (u1 0.411, u2 0.286): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 3.32 from 2023ApJS..266...41P; the 4 published values span log g 2.918 to 4.39, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.6% of the centre brightness.
